notes: Governing documents in force on the reference date: PS-12 (campus leave guidelines; 2018_01, with 2018_02 a 2019 capture whose content matches it section for section), PM-20 (LSU System leave memorandum, 2008, the stated source of PS-12), PS-36-T (2015; tenure-track policy, including IX.D adjustments to counting service toward tenure) and the Stopping the Tenure Clock Procedures (2012). The Faculty Handbook (2012) is a guide that defers to the PS and PM documents; it adds nothing beyond them except the long-term disability listing (c9, flagged summary_only). So the record is not 'no_policy_on_page' (the no-policy coding (`missing`)): governing leave and tenure-clock policies covering tenure-stream faculty are saved.

No dedicated maternity, paternity, parental or adoption leave and no paid parental benefit: PS-12 II.P and PM-20 define 'Maternity Leave' only by referral ('see Sick Leave and Family Medical Leave'). A birth parent uses her own accrued sick leave (c1; disability from childbearing) concurrently with FMLA (c2); sick leave may not be used to care for a child or for child rearing. The non-birth parent has FMLA (unpaid, or own annual leave on a 12-month appointment).

PS-12 and PM-20 state the same sick-leave, FMLA and leave-without-pay provisions; PS-12 lists PM-20 as its source and implements it for the campus (PM-20 I.D.5: each campus develops its own FMLA procedures). Each such provision is coded once, citing both, rather than as two linked components (V3c), since the terms do not differ. PM-20 alone adds Personal Leave (c5).

Whose figures: an academic-year (nine-month) tenure-stream member with two years of service. Such a member earns sick leave but not annual leave, so annual leave (c4) and crisis leave (c3, which requires eligibility to earn annual leave) are coded for the fiscal-year group by name and do not apply to the member's path.

Chain, birth parent: own accrued sick leave (c1, length = balance, unstated) with FMLA 12 workweeks (c2) running from the start (sick absences over five days designated FMLA from day one), unpaid after the balance runs out. Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c2), unpaid (annual leave only on a 12-month appointment; sick leave not usable to care for a child).

Tenure clock (c8): PS-36-T IX.D (the procedures cite it as VIII.D, an earlier numbering) and the 2012 procedures: request-based, at the System President's sole discretion, normally one year, at most two extensions for any reason. The circumstances form an open list (approved leave without pay, part-time assignment, non-tenure duties, personal obligations including pregnancy, childbirth, adoption, start-up delays and natural disasters), so it is flagged general_purpose (U1). The handbook adds that retroactive requests are considered case by case; the procedures ask for prospective requests.

Calendar: semesters (PS-36-T glossary 'Semester. A fall or spring semester, not a summer term.'; PS-12 V.A.8 credits sick leave per semester worked); no length stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Documents cited but not saved: Bylaws and Regulations of the LSU Board of Supervisors (Ch. II ss. 2-6, 2-7, 2-13; Ch. III ss. 3-1, 3-2, 3-3, 3-5; Ch. V s. 5-13; Article VIII ss. 4-5); PM-5, PM-11, PM-12, PM-13, PM-23, PM-35, PM-67 and the other PMs listed in the handbook appendix; PS-01.25, PS-1, PS-03.05, PS-03.25, PS-03.35, PS-03.40, PS-03.65, PS-03.110, PS-22, PS-25, PS-26, PS-31, PS-36-NT, PS-40, PS-43, PS-59, PS-80 and the other PSs listed in the handbook appendix; Civil Service Rules; the Stop the Tenure Clock Agreement form; the FMLA-1 form; the LSU Long Term Disability Insurance plan; the HRM benefits webpage. None of them is a parental-leave policy by its title; none is needed to code a component except the LTD plan and the Board Regulations noted in flags.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth): civil leave, voting leave, emergency leave, special leave (local conditions, official business, examinations, fellowships), military leave, funeral leave, sabbatical leave, leave to obtain an advanced degree, holidays, Workers' Compensation supplementation, the Voluntary Assistance Program (performance support). The handbook's TRSL 'provisions for disability and survivor benefits' are retirement-system benefits with no terms stated; not coded.
